"''I wish I knew.|Driver to Exmar Kloris|}} A [[human]] '''driver''' with dark skin and a [[color|black]] beard worked as the driver for a member of the [[Imperial Senate]] of the [[Galactic Empire]]. In [[2 BBY]] they were parked next to [[Senator]] [[Mon Mothma]]'s driver [[Exmar Kloris]] when Mothma gave a speech denouncing the Empire for the [[Ghorman Massacre]]. Following the end of the speech, during the Empire's rush to arrest Mothma, the driver asked Kloris if he knew what was going on, to which Kloris responded by stating that he wish he knew. ==Behind the scenes== The driver appeared in the [[Welcome to the Rebellion|ninth episode]] of the [[Andor Season 2|second season]] of the live-action [[Disney+]] series ''[[Star Wars: Andor]]'' which aired on [[May 6]], [[2025]].{{SW|url=news/andor-season-2-teaser-trailer-key-art-reveal|text=First ''Andor A Star Wars Story'' Teaser Trailer and Poster Revealed}} They were portrayed by [[Nkosi Stoole ]] in the episode and credited as simply "Other Driver". ==Appearances== *{{Andor|Welcome to the Rebellion}} {{1st}} ==Notes and references== {{Reflist}} {{Interlang |ka=სენატის უცნობი მძღოლი }} [[Category:Humans]] [[Category:Individuals of unspecified gender]] [[Category:Individuals with unspecified pronouns]] [[Category:Pilots]]
